blocks.text: Cebuano ace point guard Reinhard Jumamoy made his presence felt as National University (NU) Bulldogs scored its first victory in the UAAP Season 89 Collegiate Men’s Basketball Tournament, routing the University of the East, 76-56, on Saturday at the SMART Araneta Coliseum....
